turns.q: My order arrived and one item is damaged, what do I do?
turns.replyTail:
a few details:

Your full name
Your email address
Your order number (if you have it handy). If not, you can share the shipping address instead.
The exact name(s) of the damaged item(s)
A few clear photos of:
The outside of the box (including any visible damage)
The shipping label
The damaged item(s) themselves

You can reply here with that information and upload the photos. Once you do, I’ll pass everything along so our team can review your order and follow up with next steps.
